_doc: SOP follow-through map for assistant/scripts/followups.py. One entry per SOP with a `lane`; each step holds a TRIGGER (date | mail | manual) and an ACTION template with {var} placeholders. Date triggers may use offsets like T-14d / T+2h against the `anchor` var (or wedding_date / date). A fired step becomes an assistant TICKET (kind followup) that the operator turns into a card; nothing sends without the owner's tap. Turnaround/pricing language in instructions stays as [the owner: confirm] blanks: the assistant never commits to dates or prices.

wedding-lifecycle.title: Booked wedding: prep -> shoot -> ingest -> edit -> deliver -> review

questionnaire-reminder-2._what: T-21 days: the last questionnaire nudge, three weeks out, so the prep packet at T-14 has their answers.
questionnaire-reminder-2.subject: {couple} ({wedding_date}) - questionnaire reminder text (3 weeks out)

checkin-text._what: T-14 days: the standard check-in text (sets up the check-in call) goes by itself, zero-LLM (followups -> client_texts.auto_fire). Only when it cannot go does this reach the operator.
checkin-text.subject: {couple} ({wedding_date}) - check-in text (2 weeks out)

prep-checkin._what: T-14 days: the shoot-prep packet and the check-in email.
prep-checkin.subject: {couple} ({wedding_date}) - shoot prep + check-in

week-of-confirm._what: T-3 days: final confirmation of times, addresses, parking and who is the on-site contact.
week-of-confirm.subject: {couple} ({wedding_date}) - week-of confirmation

action.instruction: Three days to {couple}'s wedding ({wedding_date}). Post ONE decision card with the final run-of-show summary (arrival time, ceremony time, addresses, on-site contact, parking, sunset time) and anything still unknown, with a recommended action for each gap.

ingest-gate._what: T+1: cards must be offloaded and hash-verified before anything is formatted. Recurs daily until the ingest report exists.
ingest-gate.subject: {couple} - footage ingested + verified?

action.instruction: {couple}'s wedding was {wedding_date}. Find the INGEST REPORT.txt for this wedding (<storage drive>:/example-org Weddings/<wedding>/_Ingest Reports/, also D:/WeddingEditor/projects). If there is none, post a card reminding owner1 to run 'import my cards' (the footage is sacred: nothing gets formatted before two verified copies exist). Cancel this reminder ONLY when the report exists AND every card line reads 'verified copies: 2 -> card may be formatted' with no INCOMPLETE / NOT INGESTED / SAME DRIVE / ONE copy line; otherwise post a card naming the cards that are not safe yet. Cancel command: {cancel}.

thank-you._what: T+2: a short, personal thank-you / sneak-peek note. Draft only.
thank-you.subject: {couple} - day-after thank-you

action.instruction: Draft a short, warm thank-you email to {couple} for {wedding_date} in the example-org voice (no delivery date promised; say the edit is underway and owner1 will share a sneak peek when there is one). Post as an exec card from the account their thread lives on.

edit-start._what: T+7: the edit should have a project by now.
edit-start.subject: {couple} - edit started?

action.instruction: One week after {couple}'s wedding: check D:/WeddingEditor/projects for a project + transcripts. If none, post a card recommending owner1 start the wedding-edit pipeline ('start {couple}'s wedding'). Update scripts/projects/project_state.json stage when the answer is known.

delivery-check._what: Delivery SLA checkpoint. Anchor = promised_delivery when known, else wedding_date + the default turnaround in config. Recurs weekly until delivered.
delivery-check.subject: {couple} - delivery due {anchor}

action.instruction: {couple}'s film is due around {anchor} (from project_state / the default turnaround; owner1 confirms the real promise). Check the edit stage in scripts/projects/project_state.json and D:/WeddingEditor. Post ONE card: on track / at risk / overdue, with the recommended next step. When delivered, mark the project delivered and cancel this: {cancel}.

review-request._what: T+14 after delivery: ask for a review / referral. Armed by delivery-tracker when a project is marked delivered (anchor = delivered date).
review-request.subject: {couple} - review request

action.instruction: {couple}'s film was delivered around {anchor}. Draft a short, grateful email asking for a Google / The Knot review and a referral, example-org voice, exec card from the account their thread lives on.

inquiry.title: New inquiry: reply SLA -> quote follow-ups

reply-sla._what: Armed when a new inquiry is sensed. If nothing has gone out within 2 h, escalate.
reply-sla.subject: {couple} - inquiry unanswered 2h

quote-followup-48h._what: Armed when a proposal is sent. Two days later, if unsigned, nudge.
quote-followup-48h.subject: {couple} - proposal follow-up (48h)

quote-followup-7d._what: One week after the proposal: last nudge, then let it go.
quote-followup-7d.subject: {couple} - proposal follow-up (7d)

action.instruction: One week since the proposal to {couple} ({anchor}). If still unsigned, draft a final friendly check-in that leaves the door open, as an exec card. Then let it rest; the cold-leads digest will carry it.

money.title: Bills, renewals, quarterlies (track and remind; never pay)

bill-due._what: Armed from a bill/statement email with a due date (mail_arm) or from the bank feed's recurring-charge forecast (scripts/money/forecast.py). Reminds 3 days before and on the day.
bill-due.subject: {what} due {anchor}

action.instruction: {what} is due {anchor} ({amount}). Post ONE card reminding owner1 to pay it himself (the assistant never pays or enters credentials). If it is on autopay, say so and recommend Skip.

quarterly-estimate._what: Federal/CA estimated tax checkpoints. Armed by scripts/money/quarterly.py for the next due date (T-10d); the computed amount is in assistant/data/money/quarterly.json.
quarterly-estimate.subject: Estimated tax payment due {anchor}

action.instruction: Estimated tax payment is due {anchor}; the money lane's running estimate says {amount} (federal + CA; assistant/data/money/quarterly.json has the breakdown and the YTD Schedule C). Post ONE card with that amount and the two pay links (IRS Direct Pay, FTB Web Pay); owner1 pays himself, never the assistant. If quarterly.json is missing or stale, say so and give the YTD profit instead.

renewal._what: Insurance / registration / subscription renewals. Armed from a renewal email or by hand.
renewal.subject: {what} renews {anchor}

action.instruction: {what} renews on {anchor}. Post a card: keep as-is (Recommended if unchanged), shop it, or cancel; include last year's price if known.

delivery-arriving._what: Armed from a shipped notification; fires on the expected day.
delivery-arriving.subject: Delivery arriving: {what}

action.instruction: {what} is expected {anchor}. FYI note only unless a signature or someone home is required; then post a card.

maintenance._what: Recurring home tasks (HVAC filter, smoke detectors, camera/NAS backups). Armed by hand with every_days.
maintenance.subject: Home: {what}

action.instruction: Recurring home task: {what}. Post ONE card (Done / Snooze a week (Recommended if busy) / Stop reminding). Cancel with {cancel} if owner1 says stop.

reminder._what: A one-shot reminder: arm with --var what=... --var anchor=YYYY-MM-DD.
reminder.subject: Reminder: {what}

action.instruction: Reminder for owner1: {what} ({anchor}). Post a card with Done / Snooze options.

awaiting-reply._what: Armed after the owner sends someone an email he needs an answer to; fires when their reply arrives OR after N days of silence.
awaiting-reply.subject: Waiting on {who}: {what}

action.instruction: {who} replied about {what} (see the evidence mail ticket). Bring it to the front of the queue: summarise and post a card if a decision is needed.

heads-up._what: Armed by the operator when one of owner's texts mentions a future date: --var what=... --var anchor=<heads-up date>.
heads-up.subject: Heads-up: {what}

action.instruction: Heads-up for owner6: {what} (heads-up date {anchor}). Post ONE calm card in lane owner6: what is coming, what she needs to do now (buy a gift, RSVP, book a sitter...), options Done / Remind me in 3 days (Recommended if nothing is due yet) / Not needed.

any: \b(let'?s (?:do it|book it|move forward|lock it in)|we'?re in|count us in|ready to (?:book|sign|move forward))\b
\b(we (?:want|would like) to go with you|you'?re hired|book us)\b

contact.detail: copy them on every email-type send (ledger also_notify)
their details on the couple's wedding page

questionnaire_done.why: they said the questionnaire is done

reply.detail: the reply, as an exec card, naming what code already did with their message

yes_to_proposal.detail: note the yes on the project; the proposal / contract step is the operator's reply

_doc_preconditions: WP3 2026-10-24: a step's action.satisfied_when = {check, ...} is read by assistant/scripts/preconditions.py before the step fires: satisfied = done by record (no ticket, no text), moot = dismissed, open/unknown = fires with what was read as evidence. Checks: questionnaire_answered, timeline_on_file, outbound_since {days|since: anchor}, touches_sent.
